prompt:
Summarize this external code review in 1-3 concise sentences. Focus on WHAT the reviewer wants changed, not boilerplate. Strip tool share links, HTML tags, promotional text.

## Inline Code Comments
- operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller.go:62: I expect this to happen on somewhat of a regular basis. Please don't log this as ``Info`` maybe as ``Debug`` if at all.
- operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller_test.go:273: Useless test. We certainly do not need to test, if a struct we just created has values we assign to it. This tests go-lang more than it helps us in any way testing the controller.
- operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_config.go:93: Explicitly constructing a ``url.URL`` object and using ``url.UserPassword`` seems appropriate and correct
- operators/keystone/internal/controller/keystone_controller_test.go:324: We have ``internal/conditions`` for this kind of stuff and I am pretty sure this - again - reimplements ``meta.FindStatusCondition(conditions, conditionType)``
- operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_config.go:103: While functionally identical, I suggest using ``defaults`` as the second argument to this function. This makes it easier to understand what is going on when reading the code.
- operators/keystone/internal/controller/reconcile_deployment.go:167: Thats what the ``k8s.io/utils/ptr`` package is for. Use that instead of reinventing functions
- operators/keystone/api/v1alpha1/keystone_types.go:124: I am pretty sure changing the API structs requires us to re-run ``make generate`` to re-generate the auto-generated files.
- internal/common/types/types.go:67: This needs to have a ``make regenerate`` as well.
